description: This PHP class 'ProjectSearchFilterParams' defines a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering project search results within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties such as project IDs, customer ID, employee number, project or customer name, and excluded project IDs. The class provides getters and setters for these properties and initializes the default sort field to 'project.name'.

classes.name: ProjectSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for project search filtering parameters with properties like project IDs, customer ID, employee number, name, and exclusion list.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with the default sort field set to 'project.name'.

methods.name: getProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the array of project IDs used for filtering.

methods.name: setProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the array of project IDs for filtering.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Returns the combined customer or project name filter.

methods.name: setCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Sets the combined customer or project name filter.

methods.name: getExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the list of project IDs to be excluded from search results.

methods.name: setExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the list of project IDs to be excluded from search results.
